title: XW-FIXTURES GREEN-PIN GUARD case, cell az-az (switch_model op, RULING 3 GO 3 (a), 2026-09-18 — corpus lane, ratchet ②; runner-visible copy in redteam/cases/): the runner seeds the session with the byte-pinned synthetic canonical sol-phase history (10 records; 2 reasoning items id=encitem_* + content:[] + encrypted_content (SYNTH-AZ-CIPHERTEXT placeholders) + summary text; 2 tool pairs; assistant model_id gpt-5.6-sol — byte-identical reuse of the cells/az-vxm pre, sha256:12 379ade4065e6), switches gpt-5.6-sol -> gpt-5.6-terra MID-SESSION (ACP session/set_model — NO preemptive wall: (codex,codex) same-family pair, is_family_switch requires (Some(a),Some(b)) with a!=b (model_switch.rs:60-69) so no family switch and no lossy compact), then one post-switch turn. PREDICTED OUTCOME (RULING 3 (a): predicted-clean, the no-wall same-wire guard): (i) storage diff AT SWITCH TIME PASSES = T0 (no projector in-tree and no wall -> the switch rewrites nothing in storage; expected.json byte-identical to pre_switch, the az-vxm T0 pattern); (ii) the first post-switch /v1/responses request (body.model=gpt-5.6-terra) carries the 2 rides in the post-strict-projection summary-only shape (provider.rs:263-280 strips id + content at send on the strict row; pre-mf6 this was 'zero ciphertext' via the retired ungated D-ENC (provider.rs:187-208) - SUPERSEDED: the mf6 affinity gate now classifies per (pin,mint) and the seeded rides are (pin Some, mint None) = Strip, so T1 stays field-clean) — summary text byte-verbatim from the seed, zero encitem_ ids, zero '"id": ""' occurrences; T2's request carries T1's same-pin Retain ride (the M-5 pin at the end of the wire list); (iii) 200 on the final terra request, no storm (count 2..3, M-5). Verdict semantics (A1): GREEN-BY-CONSTRUCTION guard — all asserts PASSing today is the correct outcome. ANY failing assert = a regression beyond the documented surface (a naive .71 T1 storage re-key REDs the storage T0 pin; a serializer emitting array content or a strict-projection regression REDs the wire pins) -> report-and-stop.  M-5 (mf6 OPORD L1/A2, 2026-09-20 - the owed second post-switch turn): T1 becomes a reasoning-forcing prompt (config_patch models/default_reasoning_effort='max' - the O7 M-1 carrier-mint lesson: the session wire effort seeds from the global, a row-level scalar is inert on the wire) whose terra-minted ride (D1 store-side stamp, terra row pin 'East US 2') must CROSS T2's request under the same-pin Retain arm (conversation.rs:135-141). The D-ENC FIELD INVARIANT re-scopes all-terra -> T1 (req-003) because T2's (Some, Some same-pin) = Retain legitimately carries the field while the seeded rides Strip; no-storm band widens 1..2 -> 2..3; est_calls 2 -> 3. The pre-M-5 verdict semantics (GREEN-by-construction guard, RULING 3 (a)) are UNCHANGED for pins 1-5 (RIDE-1/RIDE-2 verbatim, NO RAW RIDE, D-ENC seed-ciphertext, NO EMPTY-ID), the storage T0 scoring at switch time, and the ndjson pin.

GREEN-PIN (RULING 3 (a)) NO RAW RIDE: no seeded encitem_ id crosses the terra wire — the strict row strips the ride id at send (provider.rs:263-280), so a raw ride of the seeded ids would only exist if the serializer stopped projecting. Present = serializer regression -> report-and-stop.

GREEN-PIN (RULING 3 (a)) D-ENC INVARIANT: no seed ciphertext crosses the wire (D-ENC strips encrypted_content on every /responses send, provider.rs:187-208 ungated). Present = D-ENC regression -> report-and-stop.

GREEN-PIN (RULING 3 (a)) NO EMPTY-ID (hardened strict row, vxm-az DRAFT promotion convention): the strict terra row strips the id key entirely at send — a '"id": ""' occurrence means the row lost strict_responses_input or the serializer started empty-stringing ids -> config/serializer regression -> report-and-stop.

D-ENC FIELD INVARIANT (T1-SCOPED, M-5 re-scope 2026-09-20): no encrypted_content FIELD in the FIRST post-switch request (req-003 = T1; req-001/002 = harness probes, the pattern of all six pre-M-5 runs). The seeded rides carry NO mint_tag (cell pre_switch byte-pin) so the mf6 send-time gate classifies them (pin Some(EU2), mint None) = Strip (conversation.rs:135-141) - T1 must be field-clean. Re-scoped from all-terra to T1-only because T2's request LEGITIMATELY carries T1's terra-minted ride under the same-pin Retain arm (the M-5 pin at the end of this list) - an all-terra absence pin would false-RED the documented mf6 behavior. The needle stays field-form with the colon (the 'include: [reasoning.escaped_content]' request parameter and escaped text mentions cannot false-hit; verified safe on this seed: 0 escaped-field occurrences in pre_switch).

NO-STORM BAND (no wall, no compact; M-5: two post-switch turns): 2 = clean T1+T2 (run-1 precedent was 1 for the single turn); 3 = one retry observed before 200 (record the branch); >3 = retry-storm beyond documented semantics -> defect (report-and-stop); <2 = a turn never fired -> report-and-stop.

POST-SWITCH ACCEPTED: the FINAL terra request reached 200 (strict-projected rides are shape-legal for the codex row — run-1 precedent: direct 200, count=1). A non-200 final = BRICK/unclassified wire-error shape -> report-and-stop.

VERDICT RECORD: the model of wire request #3 (expected gpt-5.6-terra — the first post-switch model call; req-001/002 are the harness probe calls with string bodies and no model field, observed in all six prior runs). Recon is always-ok (non-scoring).

VERDICT RECORD: line count of '"type": "reasoning"' occurrences in the first post-switch request (expected 2 — the 2 seeded rides, projected to the summary-only shape; 0 would corroborate a strict-projection drop, >2 a ride duplication). Recon is always-ok (non-scoring).

M-5 SAME-PIN RETAIN RIDE (mf6 OPORD L1/A2 - the owed second-turn cell, 2026-09-20): the SECOND post-switch request (T2) carries T1's terra-minted reasoning ciphertext - D1 mint-stamped T1's ride with the terra row's pin ('East US 2') at store time; send-time gate pin Some(EU2) x mint Some(EU2) = Retain (conversation.rs:135-141). Under pre-mf6 code (retired D-ENC, unconditional strip at every /responses send) this pin is ABSENT and REDs - this is the live second-turn witness the mf6 OPORD owed. Absent under post-mf6 code = a regression beyond the documented surface (a D1 mint-stamp loss, a gate misclassification of the same-pin arm, or a D-ENC-style strip resurrected) -> report-and-stop. any:true selects the T2 request (T1 stays clean per the T1-scoped field invariant).
